SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PO_NO FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DOWN' AND TARGET = 'KRILJI0001' AND KEY_9 = 'T'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'C' THEN 'N' ELSE A.STATUS END AS STATUS, A.ADD_DATE, A.ADD_TIME, A.PO_CREATE_DATE, A.AGENT, A.CUR, A.PO_TTL_AMT, A.PURCHASER_ID, A.PURCHASER_NAME, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.PO_REMARK, A.ADD_USER_ID, A.DOC_TYPE, A.PO_SUBJECT FROM ICOMPOHD A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_9 = 'T'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = 'POHD ERROR' WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_9 = 'T'
